title: Fractured World

openingPremise.description: A deliberately fictional near-future crisis starting point. The opening situation is fixed; subsequent alignments, escalation, negotiation and territorial outcomes are simulated rather than scripted.

facts: The United States has invaded and occupies Greenland.
Denmark is at war with the United States over Greenland.
EU participants, the United Kingdom and Canada have entered the war in support of Denmark.
Russia's war in Ukraine is continuing at scenario start.
Ukraine is supported by the European defence coalition.
The United States and Iran are at war at scenario start.
China has imposed a blockade on Taiwan.
The blockade does not automatically place China and the United States in a shooting war.

uncommittedPowers.description: States not assigned to an opening belligerent relationship begin free to align, remain neutral, mediate, trade, sanction, rearm or pursue their own interests according to the simulation.

status: independent baseline map, modern runtime calibration, country-first startup and opening force deployments ready for CI validation
